greeting: Namaste! I am your FarmGuard assistant. Ask me about irrigation, weather, crop choice, diseases, fertilizer or government schemes.
no_match: Sorry, I don't have a ready answer for that. Try one of the suggestions below, or ask your local KVK / Krishi officer.
need_location: Please mark your farm location on My Farm first, so I can use your weather and soil.
suggestions: What is the weather this week?
How do I get a Soil Health Card?

answers.scan_help: Open Disease Scan, take a close photo of ONE affected leaf in daylight. It works even without internet and shows treatment in Hindi or English.
answers.crop_choice: Open Crop Advisor: choose season and soil (or 'Not sure'), add your Soil Health Card if you have one, and you get the top 3 crops with expected yield, profit and a 3-season rotation plan.
answers.fertilizer: Use fertilizer based on a soil test. General rule: split urea into 2–3 doses, apply DAP/SSP at sowing, potash only if soil K is low. Never mix urea with seed. Your Soil Health Card gives exact doses — enter it in Crop Advisor to get tips.
answers.soil_card: Soil Health Card testing is free. Contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra / agriculture office or visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in. Take a soil sample from 0–15 cm depth from several spots of the field, mix, and give about 500 g.
answers.organic: Make compost from crop residue, dung and kitchen waste in a shaded pit; turn it every 15–20 days, ready in 2–3 months. Apply 2–4 tonnes FYM/compost per acre before sowing. Vermicompost improves soil quickly.
answers.pests: Scout the field twice a week. Use yellow sticky traps for whitefly/aphids, neem oil (as per label) for early attack, and spray chemicals only when damage crosses the threshold. Scan a damaged leaf in Disease Scan for specific advice.
answers.stubble: Don't burn straw — it kills soil life and is punishable. Options: Happy Seeder / Super Seeder to sow wheat into residue, PUSA bio-decomposer spray, or sell/give straw for fodder, biogas or mushroom farming via the Crop Waste Exchange.
answers.heat: During heatwave: irrigate in evening or early morning, use mulch, avoid spraying in the afternoon, give shade/water to animals, and work in the field only in cool hours.
answers.frost: On frost nights (clear sky, calm, very cold): give light irrigation in the evening, cover nursery/young plants, and smoke the field edges at night. Protect vegetables with straw covers.
answers.pm_kisan: PM-KISAN gives ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 to land-holding farmer families. Register at pmkisan.gov.in or a Common Service Centre; e-KYC and Aadhaar-linked bank account are required.
answers.insurance: PM Fasal Bima Yojana insures crops against natural disasters, pests and disease. Farmer premium: 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture). Enrol through your bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the season deadline.
answers.loan: Kisan Credit Card gives low-interest crop loans. With interest subvention the effective rate is about 4% per year if repaid on time (limit ₹3 lakh; Budget 2025-26 announced ₹5 lakh). Apply at your bank with land records and ID.
answers.price: Check MSP for your crop on the Schemes page and compare mandi prices on e-NAM (enam.gov.in). Grade and dry your produce well — it gets a better price. Government procurement at MSP is available for wheat, paddy and some pulses/oilseeds.
answers.storage: Dry grain well (below 12% moisture), clean the store, use hermetic bags or metal bins, keep bags on wooden pallets away from walls, and check monthly for insects.
answers.rent_machine: Open Rent & Waste → Equipment to find tractors, harvesters, sprayers and seeders offered by farmers near you, or list your own machine. Custom Hiring Centres also rent machines at fixed rates.
answers.family_help: Open Family. Share your 6-digit code with your son/daughter; they enter it in their FarmGuard app and can help you, receive your alerts and send you messages in your language.
answers.app_offline: Disease Scan, the treatment guide and your saved data work without internet. Weather, satellite and village alerts need internet — the app shows the last saved data with a FALLBACK badge.
